mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS articleTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newArticle, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_num), 0) FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS viewTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_view_record WHERE create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newView, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS dailyTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newDaily, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS likeTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS categoryTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS tagTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS commentTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newComment

SELECT -- 全部总量 a.articleTotal, d.dailyTotal, a.viewTotal, ul.likeTotal, c.commentTotal, cat.categoryTotal, t.tagTotal, -- 区间新增 a.newArticle, d.newDaily, avr.newView, c.newComment FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) articleTotal, IFNULL(SUM(view_num),0) viewTotal, SUM(IF(create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}, 1, 0)) newArticle FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0) a,
(SELECT COUNT(*) dailyTotal, SUM(IF(create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}, 1, 0)) newDaily FROM daily WHERE delete_flag = 0) d,
(SELECT COUNT(*) likeTotal FROM user_like WHERE delete_flag = 0) ul,
(SELECT COUNT(*) commentTotal, SUM(IF(create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}, 1, 0)) newComment FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0) c,
(SELECT COUNT(*) categoryTotal FROM category WHERE delete_flag = 0) cat,
(SELECT COUNT(*) tagTotal FROM tag WHERE delete_flag = 0) t,
(SELECT COUNT(*) newView FROM article_view_record WHERE create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) avr;
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM daily WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
SELECT IFNULL(c.name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(a.id) AS value FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE status WHEN 0 THEN '草稿' WHEN 1 THEN '已发布' WHEN 2 THEN '已下架' WHEN 3 THEN '已归档' WHEN 4 THEN '定时发布' WHEN 5 THEN '私密' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, c.name AS categoryName, a.view_num AS viewNum, a.like_num AS likeNum, a.comment_num AS commentNum, a.publish_time AS publishTime FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY a.view_num DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, LEFT(d.content, 50) AS content, d.like_num AS likeNum, d.comment_num AS commentNum, d.publish_time AS publishTime FROM daily d WHERE d.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY d.like_num DESC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS commentTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newComment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status = 1) AS normalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status = 0) AS hiddenCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND type = 0) AS articleCommentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND type = 1) AS dailyCommentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND type = 2) AS messageCommentCount
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT CASE type WHEN 0 THEN '文章评论' WHEN 1 THEN '日常评论' WHEN 2 THEN '留言板' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY type ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' WHEN 0 THEN '隐藏' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT '发文' AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS value FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND user_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '仅评论', COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND user_id IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT '纯注册', COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.delete_flag = 0 AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND user_id IS NOT NULL) AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0)

SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, IFNULL(a.cnt, 0) AS articleCount, IFNULL(c.cnt, 0) AS commentCount, (IFNULL(a.cnt, 0) + IFNULL(c.cnt, 0)) AS activityCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY user_id ) a ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY user_id ) c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY activityCount DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0) AS linkTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 0) AS pendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 1) AS approvedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 2) AS rejectedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newApply, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1) AS displayCount
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
SELECT CASE audit_status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '已通过' WHEN 2 THEN '已拒绝' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY audit_status ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT id, link_name AS linkName, link_url AS linkUrl, link_email AS linkEmail, create_time AS createTime FROM link WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND audit_status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_view_record WHERE create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newArticles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end}) AS newUsers
